title: A Yearbook for the Tryouts
author: J. M. Voss
blurb: Odile Voss, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
